category_title: Students who react with aggression or outbursts when losing or frustrated
minimal_context: The student is playing a board game involving rolling dice and moving pieces during a nurture group session.
dialogue:
TUTOR: It is your turn to roll the dice for the board game.

STUDENT: I have to win this. Winning is really important.

TUTOR: Go ahead and roll the dice to see what number you get.

STUDENT: (Rolls the dice) No! I am losing the game!

TUTOR: It is just a game, please move your piece.

STUDENT: I didn't roll the correct number! (Throws things across the table and stamps off)

options.A: Provide constant repetition of modeling, showing the skill again, and encouraging the student to try.
options.B: Change the board game routine by taking names out of a hat to nominate the players.
options.C: Implement a specific termination stage counting down the final 3-5 sessions of the nurture group.
options.D: Maintain an absence of direct intervention during the board game and nurture group sessions.
